title: LoadShapesRecord v1 — the measurer's judgement of one measurement act: a planned size measured once is accepted with the shape's total message count standing in the record; a size measured twice on one door (duplicate_size), a size outside the policy's plan (size_not_planned), or a size that is not a positive count at all (malformed_size) is refused by name, counted apart, and measures nothing — the published table can never quietly hold two shapes for one size or a shape the plan never named (Y-072)
